faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ABV-IIITM JRF / Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I posts at ABV-IIITM is 04 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are submitted via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I post in the ABV-IIITM recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the ABV-IIITM Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF / Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: For JRF, candidates need M.Tech/M.S./M.E. or equivalent in CSE/IT/EC/EE/ME with B.Tech/B.E./M.Sc. and GATE/CSIR-UGC NET. For Project Associate-I, B.Tech/BE is required.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for ABV-IIITM JRF / Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ABV-IIITM Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I recruitment. The fee is Nil for all.

faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I posts at ABV-IIITM primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications.

faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I post will be as per DST norms. Specific details can be found in the official notification released by ABV-IIITM.
